title: Global Claude.md file
body:
I'd like to be able to put a global `Claude.md` file in my home directory, e.g. `./claude/Claude.md`, to record personal coding preferences I want to use on all projects, instruct Claude how to do things like open files in my editor or browser on my machine using bash, etc. 

Or if such a facility already exists and I missed it, then better documentation would be helpful.

Thanks!
author: stevemolitor
